ID used to denote the family pregnancy based on pregnancies tied to the biological mother. ID contains three sections, a 4 digit counter for siblings or half-siblings born to the same mother (Family portion of the ID), followed by a pregnancy type (`S` for 'Singlet'; `M` for 'Multiple Birth') and a counter on the pregnancy. For example, Multiple Birth siblings from first pregnancy would have the ID `0001_M1`, a Singlet sibling from a second pregnancy would have the ID `0001_S2`.
